	To oversee and coordinate day-to-day construction activities, ensuring works are executed safely, according to approved drawings and specifications, within schedule and budget, and in line with the project&#39;s quality requirements.

	Coordinate daily site activities across civil, structural, architectural, MEP and finishing works.

	Coordinate with the Design, Engineering and QA/QC teams to resolve technical issues.
	Monitor inspections, testing and corrective actions to prevent rework.
	Ensure proper documentation of site instructions, inspections and completed works.

	Enforce site HSE policies, safe work procedures and applicable regulations.
	Identify unsafe conditions and ensure corrective actions are implemented.
	Coordinate with the HSE team to promote a safe working environment.

	Supervise subcontractors, site engineers, foremen and construction teams.
	Monitor labour productivity, material usage and equipment utilisation.
	Coordinate construction interfaces to avoid clashes, delays and unnecessary downtime.
	Escalate resource constraints, cost concerns and major site issues to the Project Manager.

	Achievement of construction milestones and approved schedules.
	Effective identification and resolution of delays.
	Compliance with approved drawings, specifications and quality standards.
	Reduction in rework, material wastage and avoidable downtime.
	Compliance with site safety requirements.
	Effective coordination of subcontractors, labour, materials and equipment.
	Timely and accurate progress reporting.

	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Civil Engineering, Building, Construction Management or a related discipline.

	Proficiency in Primavera P6 is mandatory, including schedule development, updating, progress tracking and critical-path monitoring.
	Strong understanding of construction methods, drawings, specifications, quality control and HSE requirements.
	Professional registration with COREN, CORBON or another relevant professional body is an advantage, as applicable to the candidate&#39;s discipline.


Key Competencies:


	Construction planning and site execution
	Primavera P6 scheduling and progress monitoring
	Critical-path analysis and delay recovery
	Multidisciplinary coordination
	Contractor and workforce supervision
	Quality assurance and HSE compliance
	Problem-solving and decision-making
	Reporting and stakeholder communication


Value Proposition:


	An opportunity to lead construction delivery on a landmark, international-standard tertiary hospital project and contribute to the development of a major healthcare facility in Akwa Ibom State.


Location Preference:


	Candidates currently residing in Uyo or its immediate environs are strongly preferred due to the site-based nature of the role. Candidates willing to relocate to Uyo may also be considered.

N400,000 - N600,000 / month.

title: Job Openings at Tincan Island Container Terminal Limited
content:
Tincan Island Container Terminal Limited (TICT), established in 2004, is a multinational company operating in Nigeria with its Terminal located at Tin-can Island Port, Terminal B (2nd Gate), Apapa, Lagos and has its Head Office at 1/3 Point Road, Apapa, Lagos. After a very competitive bidding process, TICT emerged as the concessionaire of Terminal B, Tincan Island Port. Armed with a long-term lease agreement with the Federal Government of Nigeria, and an unwavering commitment to continued investment in Port development, we are poised to position ourselves as a key industry player within the African sub-region.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Automation Specialist
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    



Job Location: Apapa, Lagos
Employment Type: Contract

Job Description


	The Automation Specialist also known as the RPA/BI Developer at TICT is responsible for supporting business applications, developing data models and algorithms, and creating dashboards and reports to aid decision-making.
	This role involves automating business processes through IT solutions, ensuring seamless interface and database connections, and translating business needs into technical specifications.


Key Duties and Responsibilities
Business Application Support:


	Provide ongoing support and maintenance for business applications to ensure smooth operations.
	Troubleshoot and resolve issues, ensuring minimal disruption to business activities.
	Collate and translate business needs into detailed technical specifications for development and implementation.
	Perform technical analysis and unit testing to ensure that solutions meet the specified requirements.


Dashboard and Reporting Development:


	Develop and maintain dashboards and reports that provide actionable insights to various stakeholders.
	Ensure that reports are accurate, timely, and align with business objectives.


Interface and Database Connections:


	Design, develop, and implement data models and algorithms that enhance business processes and decision-making.
	Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure data models meet business requirements.
	Manage and maintain interfaces and database connections between applications to ensure seamless data flow.
	Ensure that database connections are secure, reliable, and optimized for performance.


Process Automation and IT Solutions:


	Identify opportunities for process automation and develop IT solutions that streamline business operations.
	Implement automation tools and technologies, ensuring they are integrated effectively into existing systems.


Documentation and User Training:


	Create and maintain detailed documentation for all developed solutions and processes.
	Provide training and support to users, ensuring they are proficient in using the tools and applications.


Other Duties:


	Perform other duties as required to support the overall IT and business objectives.
	Stay updated with the latest trends and advancements in RPA and BI technologies to continually enhance TICT’s capabilities.
	Perform other duties as assigned by the Line Manager.


Qualification and Requirements


	Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field.
	Minimum of 3 years of experience in RPA/BI development or a related role.
	Certifications in business intelligence (e.g., Microsoft Power BI, Tableau) or RPA (e.g., UiPath, Automation Anywhere) are an advantage.
	Proven experience in supporting business applications, developing dashboards and reports, and automating processes.


Skills and Competency Requirement:


	In-depth understanding of business application support, data modelling, and algorithm development.
	Familiarity with business intelligence tools and RPA technologies.
	Proficiency in developing and maintaining dashboards, reports, and data models.
	Strong skills in database management, including interface and connection optimization.
	Experience with process automation tools and technologies.
	Ability to identify issues and develop effective solutions.
	Strong analytical skills for translating business needs into technical specifications.
	Effective communication skills for interacting with stakeholders and providing user support.


Total Compensation
Attractive.

Application Closing Date: 30th November, 2026. 

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Note: Only qualified candidates will be contacted.

 

2.) Facility Lead

Job Location: Apapa, Lagos
Employment Type: Contract

Job Summary


	The Facilities Lead is accountable for planning, leading, and executing daily maintenance activities at the terminal and Head Office, to meet established quality, cost, and time targets, and ensure maintenance reliability and availability of the department.


Roles and Responsibilities
Sectional Leadership:


	Cascades departmental yearly goals/performance objectives to the section
	Coordinates the preparation of a yearly implementation plan for sectional goals and performance objectives and makes regular updates as required
	Puts systems in place to monitor and evaluate the sectional plans and progres
	Provides leadership and direction for the section.


Facility Maintenance:


	Plans and directs essential maintenance of electrical appliances, waste disposal, power, and water, painting, road repair, and maintenance of lavatories subject to Technical, Legal, Finance and Management validation
	Executes maintenance activities with minimum disruption to core activities by effectively communicating with team members
	Prepares and implements a complete and effective annual & monthly maintenance schedule, for buildings, roads, drainages, sewage disposal, and fumigation.
	Processes all approved invoices including payments to vendors and settlement of utility bills – power, cleaning services, waste, etc., within stipulated timeline
	Develops, harmonizes, and monitors service level agreements with internal and external service providers for facilities, subject to Technical, Legal, Finance and Management validation
	Installs and maintains the cooling systems (air conditioners and refers)
	Verifies that the agreed work by contractors is completed satisfactorily and follows up on any deficiencies
	Coordinates the execution of agreed signages and Yard markings (containers stacking areas, pedestrian areas, etc)
	Implements the maintenance of the bole hole facility
	Resolves facility emergencies or urgent issues as they arise, with strict compliance with internal validation protocols
	Ensuring the facility meets health and safety requirements - the validation of fire hydrant and extinguisher with safety department.


Systems and Process Management:


	Plans the facilities’ future development in line with strategic business objectives subject to Technical, Legal, Finance and Management validation
	Supervises and coordinates work of contractors as directed by HOD
	Plans the best allocation and utilization of space and resources for TICT, while ensuring the maintenance of the terminal and offices.
	Develops and deploys performance management techniques to monitor and demonstrate achievement of agreed service levels.
	Updates facilities maintenance schedule, preventive policies, and procedures at regular intervals
	Adopts the TICT/Bollore group quality control approach for stipulated procedures to execute facility maintenance activities.


Budgeting and Vendor Management:


	Drafts the facilities budget and financial planning proposals subject to Technical, Finance and Management validation - and exercising delegated financial authority
	Investigates the availability and suitability of options for new services or purchases and conducting cost analysis for required goods or services to achieve maximum value for money as it relates to facilities
	Prepares accurate maintenance project invoices and reports for approval by the Technical Manager
	Prepares the maintenance budget for approval
	Minimizes financial risks to the Company.


Team and People Management:


	Plans basic and refresher training for the section
	Collates, documents, and adjusts annual leave plan for all staff within the section
	Maximises productivity of the team through the implementation of TICT’s performance management system
	Recommends appropriate training for team members to close performance & development gaps
	Supports the process of recruitment of team members.


Other Duties:


	Perform other tasks as assigned by the Line Manager.


Minimum Educational Qualifications / Certifications / Years of Experience


	HND or Bachelor’s Degree in Social Sciences or Estate Management
	HSE Level 1-3 certification (preferred).
	Minimum of 10 years of experience in relevant field or industry.


Skills and Competency Requirements:


	Understanding of corrective & preventive maintenance
	Knowledge of property & facility management
	Understanding of quality management
	Budgeting & Finance
	Project Management
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (especially MS Excel)
	Communication skills
	Organization & planning skills
	Stakeholder Management
	Maintenance strategy development & review
	Emergency preparedness and business continuity
	People management
	Leading others
	Strategic thinking
	Judgement & Decision-making
	Firm personality
	Negotiation
	Problem-solving
	Proactivity
	Objectivity
	Working under pressure
	Detail orientation
	Stress management.


Total Compensation
Attractive.

Application Closing Date: 31st October, 2026.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Note:Only qualified candidates will be contacted.

 

 

3.) Operations Coordinator

Job Location: Apapa, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	The Operations Coordinator is responsible for supervising and coordinating real-time terminal operations from the Operations Control Room to ensure safe, efficient, and hitch-free vessel and yard activities.
	The role ensures effective monitoring of vessel and yard operations via the Terminal Operating System (TOS) and CCTV systems, seamless dissemination of operational information, and strong coordination between Yard, Shipside, Equipment Control, and Planning teams to optimize terminal performance.


Roles and Responsibilities
Operations Monitoring & Control:


	Monitor live vessel and yard operations via TOS and Control Room systems
	Monitor movements of Cargo Handling Equipment (CHE) across yard, shipside, and terminal through CCTV Ensure efficient use and application of TOS in monitoring and controlling operations
	Ensure smooth and uninterrupted operational flow during vessel and yard activities
	Identify operational bottlenecks and escalate promptly
	Maintain accurate operational logs and Control Room records.


Information Dissemination & Coordination:


	Disseminate relevant and accurate operational information/data to Yard and Ship-side teams in real time
	Ensure efficient execution of instructions provided by the Planning team
	Update vessel operation sequences based on planning instructions
	Ensure effective coordination with Yard and Ship-side teams for hitch-free operations.


Vessel Operations Coordination:


	Monitor live vessel operations and provide real-time updates
	Communicate with shippingagents regarding vessel operational status to support planning of berthing and sailing
	Plan and coordinate vessel and terminal operations for optimal performance
	Send soft copies of vessel departure reports at completion of operations to Vessel Command, Shipping Lines, Vessel Planners/Agents, and internal TICT recipients
	Prepare shift reports summarizing vessel productivity, yard performance, delays, and key operational events.


Performance Monitoring & Problem Resolution


	Report major operational delays or disruptions and propose corrective solutions
	Analyse causes of delays associated with vessel and yard operations
	Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance productivity and turnaround time
	Monitor vessel productivity, yard performance, and equipment allocation through TOS dashboards
	Liaise with Equipment Control team for proper distribution of equipment
	Coordinate with Technical Department and Plant unit for equipment availability and fault resolution


Other Duties:


	Perform any other operations-related duties as may be required to support terminal efficiency and productivity


Requirements
Minimum Educational Qualifications / Certifications / Years of Experience


	HND / Bachelor's Degree in Maritime Studies, Logistics, Transport Management, Engineering, or related field.
	Minimum of 6 years of experience in terminal/port operations, with at least 3 years in a supervisory or control room role.
	Port or Shipping Operations Training.
	Experience in vessel planning or yard operations coordination is an advantage.


Skills and Competency Requirements:


	Knowledge of cargo handling equipment deployment and coordination
	Strong knowledge of port/terminal operations (yard and shipside)
	Proficiency in Terminal Operating System (TOS)
	Ability to interpret operational dashboards and productivity metrics
	Strong coordination and multitasking ability
	Excellent communication and real-time decision-making skills
	High level of situational awareness and attention to detail
	Ability to perform effectively under pressure in a 24/7 shift environment.


Total Compensation
Attractive.

Application Closing Date: 31st October, 2026.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Note: Only qualified candidates will be contacted.

  "title": "Executive Assistant - Hospitality",
  "description": "Domeo Resources International (DRI) is a prolific organisation which proffers HR and Management Consultancy solutions premised on excellence and innovation. DRI analyses various organisational problems, develops improvement plans, deploys those plans and monitors the plans to ensure improved organisational performance.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Executive Assistant - Hospitality

Job Location: Abuja (FCT)&nbsp;
Reports to: Group Managing Director / Group CEO / Head of Real Estate
Direct Reports: Administrative Assistants, Project Support Staff and other personnel assigned to the Real Estate Office, where applicable

Main Functions


	The Executive Assistant - Hospitality provides high-level executive, administrative and operational coordination support to the Group Head of Hospitality and other designated senior executives.
	The role supports the effective administration and coordination of the Group&#39;s hospitality businesses, including hotels, restaurants, lounges, bars, banquet and event facilities, catering operations and other hospitality-related businesses.
	The Executive Assistant will coordinate information and communication between the Hospitality Executive, General Managers, Hotel Managers, Heads of Departments, Finance, HR, Sales &amp; Marketing, Procurement, Engineering, Food &amp; Beverage and other Group functions.
	The role is responsible for maintaining accurate operational records, coordinating meetings and inspections, tracking Management directives, preparing reports and presentations, monitoring key operational activities and ensuring that outstanding actions across the hospitality businesses are followed through to completion.
	The position requires strong organisation, hospitality awareness, discretion, attention to detail and the ability to work effectively with senior management and multiple hospitality locations.


Role Responsibilities
Executive Support:


	Provide comprehensive executive and administrative support to the Group Head of Hospitality.
	Manage the Executive&#39;s calendar, appointments, meetings and engagements.
	Coordinate daily schedules and ensure timely communication of commitments.
	Prepare meeting agendas, briefing notes, reports and presentations.
	Assist the Executive in preparing for operational and strategic meetings.
	Coordinate travel arrangements and itineraries where required.
	Manage correspondence and requests directed to the Hospitality Executive.
	Maintain an organised system for tracking executive assignments and deadlines.


Hospitality Portfolio Coordination:


	Maintain an up-to-date record of all hospitality businesses within the Group.
	Maintain profiles of hotels, restaurants, lounges, bars, banquet facilities and other hospitality operations.
	Maintain information on room inventory, outlets, facilities and key operational activities where required.
	Track the operational status of hospitality properties and business units.
	Compile information from individual properties for Group-level reporting.
	Ensure hospitality portfolio information is accurate and regularly updated.
	Assist Management in monitoring the performance and development of hospitality businesses.


Hotel Operations Coordination:


	Coordinate the collection of operational information from General Managers and Hotel Managers.
	Track hotel operational reports and key Management submissions.
	Follow up on outstanding operational issues and Management directives.
	Coordinate information between Group Hospitality Management and individual hotels.
	Monitor deadlines for reports, inspections, meetings and operational initiatives.
	Assist with coordination of hotel improvement and operational projects.
	Escalate significant operational issues to the Hospitality Executive.


Food &amp; Beverage Coordination:


	Support the Hospitality Executive in monitoring restaurants, bars, lounges, banqueting and other F&amp;B operations.
	Coordinate collection of F&amp;B performance reports from relevant managers.
	Track major F&amp;B initiatives, promotions and operational projects.
	Assist in monitoring outlet openings, renovations and improvement activities.
	Coordinate meetings with F&amp;B Managers, Restaurant Managers and other relevant personnel.
	Follow up on agreed actions arising from F&amp;B meetings.
	Maintain relevant records and reports for Management review.


Guest Experience and Service Standards:


	Support Management in monitoring guest experience initiatives across hospitality businesses.
	Coordinate information relating to guest feedback, complaints and service improvement initiatives.
	Track recurring guest service issues requiring Management attention.
	Maintain records of approved service improvement initiatives.
	Coordinate follow-up with relevant departments on unresolved guest experience matters.
	Assist in monitoring compliance with established hospitality standards.
	Escalate serious or recurring service concerns to the appropriate Executive.


Management Meetings and Coordination:


	Coordinate meetings involving the Hospitality Executive and property management teams.
	Prepare meeting agendas and supporting documents.
	Schedule meetings with General Managers, Hotel Managers and Heads of Departments.
	Record or coordinate the preparation of meeting minutes.
	Maintain action trackers for all Hospitality Management meetings.
	Follow up with responsible personnel on agreed actions.
	Provide regular updates on outstanding matters.
	Ensure meeting records are properly maintained.


Property Visits and Inspections:


	Coordinate visits and inspections to hotels and other hospitality locations.
	Prepare schedules and itineraries for Management visits.
	Coordinate attendance of relevant property management personnel.
	Prepare relevant reports and documents for inspections.
	Record key observations and action points from visits.
	Follow up on issues identified during inspections.
	Maintain records of inspection reports and corrective actions.


Performance Reporting:


	Collect and compile operational reports from hospitality subsidiaries.
	Prepare periodic reports for the Hospitality Executive.
	Track key operational performance indicators.
	Compile information on occupancy, room revenue, ADR, RevPAR, F&amp;B revenue, event revenue and other approved hospitality metrics.
	Track departmental performance reports from individual properties.
	Assist in identifying significant changes or performance issues for Management attention.
	Prepare presentations and summaries for Management meetings.
	Ensure all information presented is accurate and properly supported.


Financial and Commercial Coordination:


	Liaise with Finance on hospitality-related financial information as required.
	Assist in compiling budgets, expenditure reports and financial performance information.
	Track approved capital expenditure and major operational projects.
	Monitor information relating to revenue-generating initiatives.
	Assist in coordinating financial information required for hospitality investment proposals.
	Follow up on approved financial actions.
	Escalate significant financial or commercial issues to the appropriate authority.


Sales, Marketing and Business Development Support:


	Support coordination between Hospitality Management and the Sales &amp; Marketing function.
	Track major sales initiatives, corporate partnerships and hospitality promotions.
	Assist in coordinating &nbsp;business development meetings.
	Maintain records of important hospitality partnerships and commercial initiatives.
	Follow up on approved marketing and sales actions.
	Assist in preparing reports on business development activities.
	Support coordination of major events, conferences and corporate hospitality engagements.


Human Resources and Workforce Coordination:


	Coordinate with HR on hospitality staffing and workforce-related matters as directed.
	Track approved recruitment, staffing and organisational initiatives.
	Maintain records of Management decisions relating to hospitality personnel.
	Assist in coordinating training programmes and management development initiatives.
	Follow up on approved HR actions affecting hospitality operations.
	Ensure relevant reports are provided to the Hospitality Executive.
	Maintain confidentiality of employee and management information.


Procurement and Operational Support:


	Coordinate with Procurement and Stores on hospitality operational requirements where assigned.
	Track major procurement requests and approved operational projects.
	Follow up on critical supplies, equipment and operational requirements.
	Assist in monitoring procurement-related actions requiring Management attention.
	Coordinate information between hospitality properties and central procurement functions.
	Escalate critical supply or procurement issues affecting operations.


Projects and Hospitality Development:


	Provide administrative support for new hotel, restaurant and hospitality development projects.
	Track project milestones and key deliverables.
	Coordinate information from architects, consultants, contractors and project teams.
	Maintain project schedules and action trackers.
	Assist with coordination of renovation, refurbishment and expansion projects.
	Follow up on project documentation and Management directives.
	Prepare project status reports for the Hospitality Executive.
	Escalate delays and significant project issues.


Correspondence and Communication:


	Draft and format official correspondence for the Hospitality Executive.
	Manage incoming and outgoing correspondence requiring executive attention.
	Prepare letters, memos, notices and internal communications.
	Coordinate communication between Group Hospitality Management and individual properties.
	Ensure correspondence is properly referenced and filed.
	Maintain professional communication with internal and external stakeholders.
	Follow up on communications requiring action.


Documentation and Records Management:


	Maintain organised physical and electronic records for the Hospitality Office.
	Maintain property reports, operational records, meeting minutes and action trackers.
	Maintain records of Management directives and approved initiatives.
	Ensure documents are properly classified and securely stored.
	Maintain appropriate version control of reports and documents.
	Retrieve information promptly when required.
	Protect confidential business and operational information.


Hospitality Standards and Compliance Coordination:


	Assist in monitoring compliance with Group hospitality policies and standards.
	Track required licences, permits, inspections and certifications where applicable.
	Maintain a compliance deadline tracker for hospitality properties.
	Coordinate with relevant departments on outstanding compliance matters.
	Follow up on required inspections and renewals.
	Escalate significant compliance concerns to Management.
	Assist in ensuring that approved operational standards are consistently monitored.


Market Research and Business Intelligence:


	Conduct research on hospitality trends as directed by Management.
	Monitor developments within the hotel, restaurant and broader hospitality market.
	Gather information on competitors, customer trends, hospitality concepts and new opportunities.
	Prepare summaries and briefing notes for Management.
	Support research for proposed hospitality investments and expansions.
	Maintain relevant market intelligence for Management use.


Stakeholder Management:


	Coordinate communication with General Managers, Hotel Managers, F&amp;B Managers and other hospitality leaders.
	Liaise with consultants, suppliers, contractors and service providers as directed.
	Assist in coordinating meetings with external stakeholders.
	Maintain professional relationships with key stakeholders.
	Ensure information is communicated accurately and promptly.
	Escalate sensitive or significant matters to the Hospitality Executive.


Follow-Up and Action Tracking:


	Maintain a comprehensive Hospitality Management action tracker.
	Monitor deadlines arising from Management meetings, inspections and directives.
	Follow up with responsible personnel across hospitality properties.
	Identify overdue actions and escalate appropriately.
	Track completion of approved initiatives.
	Prepare regular outstanding-action reports.
	Ensure Management decisions are properly documented and followed through.


Confidentiality and Continuous Improvement:


	Maintain strict confidentiality of operational, financial, commercial and executive information.
	Ensure sensitive documents are securely maintained.
	Protect information relating to guests, employees, Management and business partners.
	Identify opportunities to improve Hospitality Office processes.
	Develop effective systems for reporting, tracking and coordination.
	Recommend improvements to executive and hospitality administration.
	Perform other duties reasonably assigned by the Group Head of Hospitality or Management.


Qualifications and Requirements
Education:


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree/HND in Hospitality Management, Hotel Management, Business Administration, Management, Tourism, Public Administration or a related discipline.
	A postgraduate qualification in Hospitality Management, Business Administration or a related field is an advantage.


Experience:


	Minimum of 4&ndash;7 years of relevant professional experience.
	Experience in executive assistance, hospitality administration, hotel operations or corporate coordination.
	Experience supporting senior executives or management.
	Experience working across multiple hotel or hospitality locations is an advantage.
	Strong understanding of hotel operations and hospitality business functions.
	Experience within a Group or multi-business organisation is desirable.


Skills:


	Executive Office Management
	Hospitality Operations Coordination
	Hotel Administration
	Project Coordination
	Management Reporting
	Meeting &amp; Calendar Management
	Guest Experience Awareness
	F&amp;B Operations Awareness
	Sales &amp; Marketing Coordination
	Property Inspection Coordination
	Document &amp; Records Management
	Microsoft Office Suite
	Excel &amp; Data Management
	Research &amp; Report Writing
	Stakeholder Management
	Communication Skills
	Follow-Up &amp; Coordination
	Time Management
	Attention to Detail
	Problem-Solving
	Commercial Awareness
	Professional Discretion
	Confidentiality.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their CVs and cover letters to: recruitment@domeoresources.org with &quot;EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT &ndash; HOSPITALITY, Abuja&quot; as the subject of the email.

Executive Assistant - Hospitality Job at Domeo Resources International (DRI)




        
    

        
        Domeo Resources International (DRI) is a prolific organisation which proffers HR and Management Consultancy solutions premised on excellence and innovation. DRI analyses various organisational problems, develops improvement plans, deploys those plans and monitors the plans to ensure improved organisational performance.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Executive Assistant - Hospitality

Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 
Reports to: Group Managing Director / Group CEO / Head of Real Estate
Direct Reports: Administrative Assistants, Project Support Staff and other personnel assigned to the Real Estate Office, where applicable

Main Functions
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	The Executive Assistant - Hospitality provides high-level executive, administrative and operational coordination support to the Group Head of Hospitality and other designated senior executives.
	The role supports the effective administration and coordination of the Group's hospitality businesses, including hotels, restaurants, lounges, bars, banquet and event facilities, catering operations and other hospitality-related businesses.
	The Executive Assistant will coordinate information and communication between the Hospitality Executive, General Managers, Hotel Managers, Heads of Departments, Finance, HR, Sales & Marketing, Procurement, Engineering, Food & Beverage and other Group functions.
	The role is responsible for maintaining accurate operational records, coordinating meetings and inspections, tracking Management directives, preparing reports and presentations, monitoring key operational activities and ensuring that outstanding actions across the hospitality businesses are followed through to completion.
	The position requires strong organisation, hospitality awareness, discretion, attention to detail and the ability to work effectively with senior management and multiple hospitality locations.


Role Responsibilities
Executive Support:


	Provide comprehensive executive and administrative support to the Group Head of Hospitality.
	Manage the Executive's calendar, appointments, meetings and engagements.
	Coordinate daily schedules and ensure timely communication of commitments.
	Prepare meeting agendas, briefing notes, reports and presentations.
	Assist the Executive in preparing for operational and strategic meetings.
	Coordinate travel arrangements and itineraries where required.
	Manage correspondence and requests directed to the Hospitality Executive.
	Maintain an organised system for tracking executive assignments and deadlines.


Hospitality Portfolio Coordination:


	Maintain an up-to-date record of all hospitality businesses within the Group.
	Maintain profiles of hotels, restaurants, lounges, bars, banquet facilities and other hospitality operations.
	Maintain information on room inventory, outlets, facilities and key operational activities where required.
	Track the operational status of hospitality properties and business units.
	Compile information from individual properties for Group-level reporting.
	Ensure hospitality portfolio information is accurate and regularly updated.
	Assist Management in monitoring the performance and development of hospitality businesses.


Hotel Operations Coordination:


	Coordinate the collection of operational information from General Managers and Hotel Managers.
	Track hotel operational reports and key Management submissions.
	Follow up on outstanding operational issues and Management directives.
	Coordinate information between Group Hospitality Management and individual hotels.
	Monitor deadlines for reports, inspections, meetings and operational initiatives.
	Assist with coordination of hotel improvement and operational projects.
	Escalate significant operational issues to the Hospitality Executive.


Food & Beverage Coordination:


	Support the Hospitality Executive in monitoring restaurants, bars, lounges, banqueting and other F&B operations.
	Coordinate collection of F&B performance reports from relevant managers.
	Track major F&B initiatives, promotions and operational projects.
	Assist in monitoring outlet openings, renovations and improvement activities.
	Coordinate meetings with F&B Managers, Restaurant Managers and other relevant personnel.
	Follow up on agreed actions arising from F&B meetings.
	Maintain relevant records and reports for Management review.


Guest Experience and Service Standards:


	Support Management in monitoring guest experience initiatives across hospitality businesses.
	Coordinate information relating to guest feedback, complaints and service improvement initiatives.
	Track recurring guest service issues requiring Management attention.
	Maintain records of approved service improvement initiatives.
	Coordinate follow-up with relevant departments on unresolved guest experience matters.
	Assist in monitoring compliance with established hospitality standards.
	Escalate serious or recurring service concerns to the appropriate Executive.


Management Meetings and Coordination:


	Coordinate meetings involving the Hospitality Executive and property management teams.
	Prepare meeting agendas and supporting documents.
	Schedule meetings with General Managers, Hotel Managers and Heads of Departments.
	Record or coordinate the preparation of meeting minutes.
	Maintain action trackers for all Hospitality Management meetings.
	Follow up with responsible personnel on agreed actions.
	Provide regular updates on outstanding matters.
	Ensure meeting records are properly maintained.


Property Visits and Inspections:


	Coordinate visits and inspections to hotels and other hospitality locations.
	Prepare schedules and itineraries for Management visits.
	Coordinate attendance of relevant property management personnel.
	Prepare relevant reports and documents for inspections.
	Record key observations and action points from visits.
	Follow up on issues identified during inspections.
	Maintain records of inspection reports and corrective actions.


Performance Reporting:


	Collect and compile operational reports from hospitality subsidiaries.
	Prepare periodic reports for the Hospitality Executive.
	Track key operational performance indicators.
	Compile information on occupancy, room revenue, ADR, RevPAR, F&B revenue, event revenue and other approved hospitality metrics.
	Track departmental performance reports from individual properties.
	Assist in identifying significant changes or performance issues for Management attention.
	Prepare presentations and summaries for Management meetings.
	Ensure all information presented is accurate and properly supported.


Financial and Commercial Coordination:


	Liaise with Finance on hospitality-related financial information as required.
	Assist in compiling budgets, expenditure reports and financial performance information.
	Track approved capital expenditure and major operational projects.
	Monitor information relating to revenue-generating initiatives.
	Assist in coordinating financial information required for hospitality investment proposals.
	Follow up on approved financial actions.
	Escalate significant financial or commercial issues to the appropriate authority.


Sales, Marketing and Business Development Support:


	Support coordination between Hospitality Management and the Sales & Marketing function.
	Track major sales initiatives, corporate partnerships and hospitality promotions.
	Assist in coordinating  business development meetings.
	Maintain records of important hospitality partnerships and commercial initiatives.
	Follow up on approved marketing and sales actions.
	Assist in preparing reports on business development activities.
	Support coordination of major events, conferences and corporate hospitality engagements.


Human Resources and Workforce Coordination:


	Coordinate with HR on hospitality staffing and workforce-related matters as directed.
	Track approved recruitment, staffing and organisational initiatives.
	Maintain records of Management decisions relating to hospitality personnel.
	Assist in coordinating training programmes and management development initiatives.
	Follow up on approved HR actions affecting hospitality operations.
	Ensure relevant reports are provided to the Hospitality Executive.
	Maintain confidentiality of employee and management information.


Procurement and Operational Support:


	Coordinate with Procurement and Stores on hospitality operational requirements where assigned.
	Track major procurement requests and approved operational projects.
	Follow up on critical supplies, equipment and operational requirements.
	Assist in monitoring procurement-related actions requiring Management attention.
	Coordinate information between hospitality properties and central procurement functions.
	Escalate critical supply or procurement issues affecting operations.


Projects and Hospitality Development:


	Provide administrative support for new hotel, restaurant and hospitality development projects.
	Track project milestones and key deliverables.
	Coordinate information from architects, consultants, contractors and project teams.
	Maintain project schedules and action trackers.
	Assist with coordination of renovation, refurbishment and expansion projects.
	Follow up on project documentation and Management directives.
	Prepare project status reports for the Hospitality Executive.
	Escalate delays and significant project issues.


Correspondence and Communication:


	Draft and format official correspondence for the Hospitality Executive.
	Manage incoming and outgoing correspondence requiring executive attention.
	Prepare letters, memos, notices and internal communications.
	Coordinate communication between Group Hospitality Management and individual properties.
	Ensure correspondence is properly referenced and filed.
	Maintain professional communication with internal and external stakeholders.
	Follow up on communications requiring action.


Documentation and Records Management:


	Maintain organised physical and electronic records for the Hospitality Office.
	Maintain property reports, operational records, meeting minutes and action trackers.
	Maintain records of Management directives and approved initiatives.
	Ensure documents are properly classified and securely stored.
	Maintain appropriate version control of reports and documents.
	Retrieve information promptly when required.
	Protect confidential business and operational information.


Hospitality Standards and Compliance Coordination:


	Assist in monitoring compliance with Group hospitality policies and standards.
	Track required licences, permits, inspections and certifications where applicable.
	Maintain a compliance deadline tracker for hospitality properties.
	Coordinate with relevant departments on outstanding compliance matters.
	Follow up on required inspections and renewals.
	Escalate significant compliance concerns to Management.
	Assist in ensuring that approved operational standards are consistently monitored.


Market Research and Business Intelligence:


	Conduct research on hospitality trends as directed by Management.
	Monitor developments within the hotel, restaurant and broader hospitality market.
	Gather information on competitors, customer trends, hospitality concepts and new opportunities.
	Prepare summaries and briefing notes for Management.
	Support research for proposed hospitality investments and expansions.
	Maintain relevant market intelligence for Management use.


Stakeholder Management:


	Coordinate communication with General Managers, Hotel Managers, F&B Managers and other hospitality leaders.
	Liaise with consultants, suppliers, contractors and service providers as directed.
	Assist in coordinating meetings with external stakeholders.
	Maintain professional relationships with key stakeholders.
	Ensure information is communicated accurately and promptly.
	Escalate sensitive or significant matters to the Hospitality Executive.


Follow-Up and Action Tracking:


	Maintain a comprehensive Hospitality Management action tracker.
	Monitor deadlines arising from Management meetings, inspections and directives.
	Follow up with responsible personnel across hospitality properties.
	Identify overdue actions and escalate appropriately.
	Track completion of approved initiatives.
	Prepare regular outstanding-action reports.
	Ensure Management decisions are properly documented and followed through.


Confidentiality and Continuous Improvement:


	Maintain strict confidentiality of operational, financial, commercial and executive information.
	Ensure sensitive documents are securely maintained.
	Protect information relating to guests, employees, Management and business partners.
	Identify opportunities to improve Hospitality Office processes.
	Develop effective systems for reporting, tracking and coordination.
	Recommend improvements to executive and hospitality administration.
	Perform other duties reasonably assigned by the Group Head of Hospitality or Management.


Qualifications and Requirements
Education:


	Bachelor's Degree/HND in Hospitality Management, Hotel Management, Business Administration, Management, Tourism, Public Administration or a related discipline.
	A postgraduate qualification in Hospitality Management, Business Administration or a related field is an advantage.


Experience:


	Minimum of 4–7 years of relevant professional experience.
	Experience in executive assistance, hospitality administration, hotel operations or corporate coordination.
	Experience supporting senior executives or management.
	Experience working across multiple hotel or hospitality locations is an advantage.
	Strong understanding of hotel operations and hospitality business functions.
	Experience within a Group or multi-business organisation is desirable.


Skills:


	Executive Office Management
	Hospitality Operations Coordination
	Hotel Administration
	Project Coordination
	Management Reporting
	Meeting & Calendar Management
	Guest Experience Awareness
	F&B Operations Awareness
	Sales & Marketing Coordination
	Property Inspection Coordination
	Document & Records Management
	Microsoft Office Suite
	Excel & Data Management
	Research & Report Writing
	Stakeholder Management
	Communication Skills
	Follow-Up & Coordination
	Time Management
	Attention to Detail
	Problem-Solving
	Commercial Awareness
	Professional Discretion
	Confidentiality.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their CVs and cover letters to: [email protected] with "EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT – HOSPITALITY, Abuja" as the subject of the email.

Note: Only shortlisted and candidates will be contacted.
